6607a0895818414d0731.text: This part of the module will teach you different verbs that you can use to communicate

07990c762a75380e478b.text: your emotions or opinions to certain issues.

a4131f68607864cee11e.text: Read the dialogue between Noel and Nanay. Study the underlined verbs.

bbbc4abb8b92a676e1bd.text: Sample sentences taken from the dialogue:

bf43c11f4275fe4e5f3b.text: 1. You better stay home. The possibility of you getting sick scares me.

4e2f2b2f6b5c9fa48e39.text: (The verb “scarefs” is used to state the unpleasant emotion towards the possibility of getting sick. Stating an emotion is a way in convincing someone.)

e19147e5a706fa7fadbf.text: 2. No, Noel. I strongly disagree. You should follow what I tell you. (The verb disagree states the stand of the speaker. Emphasizing a stand is a good way in influencing someone to agree with your ideas.)

0155eb8538486992002a.text: In Module 3, you have learned that modal verbs have different uses. The modals

54da19d03422f6584727.text: given below are verbs that express suggestion or recommendation which is an effective way to convince or persuade. To further clarify the difference of each modal, they are arranged from weakest to strongest in terms of expressing a suggestion or recommendation. Furthermore, the table shows their functions and examples.

6ab92399e938bb1f4c42.text: Type of  Functions Examples  Verb     Modals    Could   It is used to give a suggestion which a person may or may not follow. I suggest you play with your brother and sister or you could join me pray for your Tatay’s safety. (The modal could is used to give a suggestion that the person could join the speaker in praying.) Should   It is also used to give a suggestion but more insistent than the modal could. No, Noel. I strongly disagree. You should follow what I tell you. (The modal should is used to suggest that the person needs to follow what the speaker tells.)
rows: It is used to give a suggestion which a person may or may not follow.
I suggest you play with your brother and sister or you could join me pray for your Tatay’s safety. (The modal could is used to give a suggestion that the person could join the speaker in praying.)
It is also used to give a suggestion but more insistent than the modal could.
No, Noel. I strongly disagree. You should follow what I tell you. (The modal should is used to suggest that the person needs to follow what the speaker tells.)
It is used to formally give an advice or a recommendation usually coming from an expert.
The Department of Health (DOH) recommends that people ought to stay at home so that they will not get sick. (The modal ought to is used to formally suggest that staying at home is important.)
It is used to give a recommendation by presenting the possible negative consequence if the advice is not followed.

During the Enhanced Community Quarantine (ECQ), you had better wear your mask in public places or the police will arrest you. (The modal had better is used since the possible negative consequence, the police will arrest you, is presented to serve as a warning.)
It is used to show a strong obligation that needs to be followed.

The government must control the people’s movement in public to stop the spread of the virus. (The modal must is used to express the strong obligation of the government in taking action against the spread of the virus.)

The Department of Health (DOH) recommends that people ought to stay at home so that they will not get sick. (The modal ought to is used to formally suggest that staying at home is important.) During the Enhanced Community Quarantine (ECQ), you had better wear your mask in public places or the police will arrest you. (The modal had better is used since the possible negative consequence, the police will arrest you, is presented to serve as a warning.) (The modal must is used to express the strong obligation of the government in taking action against the spread of the virus.)

042781387c14711a9214.text: You have learned in Lesson 1 that there are verbs that can be used to express your

6a10360ebe02b8623d91.text: emotions and reactions. This time, you will learn a set of adjectives that can also help tell your emotions on a certain issue.

4f5b638ed206767a15b0.text: Describing nouns and pronouns is not the only function of an adjective. It could also

1b6a5f84c2513c444c73.text: be used to express varied emotional responses and reactions to an issue. To effectively convince the readers, one must know how to appropriately use adjectives that express positive and negative emotions in creating statements and paragraphs.

16ca0fa11e1eb5bb28ea.text: Below are the adjectives that are used to show positive and negative emotions.

8b101c99ce943ddaf7ab.text: Take a look at how these adjectives are used in sentences to convey emotions.

55ef77d36f7fd956cd29.text: 1. As your friend, I will be delighted if you share your problems to me. (In this sentence, the word delighted describes the positive feeling of the person about being able to listen to his or her friend’s problems.)

50410b5015af206b7363.text: 2. Some teenagers are regretful that they were not able to spend time with their friends

79e28a8c78ff825a351c.text: (The word regretful emphasizes the teenagers’ negative emotion on not being able to be with their friends before the ECQ.)

f82fc277bcb8ee86e6c5.text: and negative circumstances that a person could experience in a day.

e84901d68720d40c8396.text: In the 3rd sentence, the word embarrassed is used to describe the feelings of young

977ea90d581e85820911.text: Now, take a look at another paragraph that uses adjectives together with the verbs

d762cdea5b2da6103a6e.text: that you have learned in Lesson 1. These range of adjectives and verbs are commonly used in writing a persuasive paragraph.

7a6b94865568181431a3.text: We all know that good nutrition is important, but the pandemic definitely made us

8147a3da11ba61404c83.text: realize that we must practice eating healthy at all times. As always mentioned by health professionals, we ought to eat a well-balanced diet accompanied with regular exercise. Absolutely, this is essential in maintaining physical health as well as mental health.

490c782d1cf933cdd1e6.text: Without this, we are completely not safe from getting the deadly virus. So, why wait for this frightening moment to happen? Start eating nutritious food and motivate others to do the same.

e599097a4911561b5569.text: In Lesson 1 and Lesson 2, you were introduced to using a range of verbs and

b961216cbcc07cca172d.text: adjectives in expressing your emotions and opinions. This time you will learn about adverbs.

ee84ec59248067415d36.text: The sentences below are based on the Story of the Aged Mother. Try to compare

0037f21838ec95b4a1bd.text: them and take note of their differences.

The farmer in the story was

652244215b8acbe4fe76.text: I agree that old people must  be respected and protected.  The farmer in the story was  happy that her mother saved  the people.

labels.text: The farmer in the story was

cddcc83c30d46e38c3c6.text: strongly  agree that old  people must be respected and  protected.  The farmer in the story was  really  happy that her mother  saved the people.

294a142ab35f45e755ae.text: What is the difference between sentence 1 and sentence 2? How about sentence 3

aae08bfb6c19df9a7600.text: and sentence 4? Which sentences sound more convincing to you?

d9a159505188a772b034.text: Notice that sentences 2 contains the words “strongly”. This word gives a higher

7b6a416f1181b65a1b2a.text: emotional degree on the verb agree. Also, take note that sentence 4 contains the word “really”. This word emphasizes that the happiness felt by the farmer is more intense than the happiness expressed in sentence 1.

3b06b6fcef30a2230515.text: The words “strongly” and “really” are examples of adverbs. They describe verbs,

d69aab364761b3d02937.text: adjectives, and another adverb. There are many types of adverbs but in this lesson, you will focus on adverbs that can give emphasis on your responses and reactions. They are called adverbs of opinion.

506ca0ef39a4d545ad2f.text: This type of adverbs emphasizes the intensity of your stand or opinion. They help

9109f0081803c4019d9b.text: clarify your belief about a certain issue.
